findings.title: Schema migration crossed the NVS string ceiling for a previously persistable profile
findings.reproduction: nvs-limit-profile1.json is parser-valid schema1 and 3775 bytes. Actual cJSON normalization yields parser-valid schema2 of4033 bytes. Pinned SDK nvs.h:295 limits NVS strings to4000 bytes including NUL, while the old target save route accepted up to16384 before nvs_set_str. The legacy profile could load but could no longer be explicitly saved after migration; the host would save it.

resolution.behavior: Bounded <=16384-byte blob in existing ecu_config/profile_blob. Boot reads only, prefers a valid blob, uses the retained legacy string only when blob is absent, rejects present invalid blob. Successful save commits blob before publishing runtime. Commit errors retain runtime, finish the configuration fence using the previous revision, and block further saves.

findings.objection_limit: The error path already failed safely before the fix. This was a functional persistence/migration regression, not evidence of a physical output hazard. Native API models do not establish real flash recovery/atomicity/capacity.

review_observations.core: Normalization uses instantaneous connector voltage times calibration reference over measured rail. Raw input fault thresholds precede ratio conversion faults; display samples normalize before smoothing. Engine binding remains instantaneous.
review_observations.schema: Schema1 success explicitly clears both new settings on every sensor, including reused Config objects. Schema2 requires fields. Mixed schema1/new fields reject. In-place document upgrade is used only after validation and caller-owned allocation failures are discarded.
review_observations.ui: Ratio/reference/mode changes clear confirmation; capture uses edited settings and rejects stale/failed/invalid-supply observations. Saved conversions remain separate. Legacy-backend capability logic was source-reviewed and the existing authored8-check browser result was inspected; independent7-check UI run did not emulate an old backend.
review_observations.docs: Final docs/guides state Off defaults, sensor-documentation prerequisite, absolute raw faults, normalization limits, unchanged engine rail guard/output inhibit, blob capacity/recovery limits, downgrade behavior and conditional simulation scope. No unsupported physical qualification claim found in reviewed final docs.
review_observations.source_transition: Parent fixed the discovered persistence regression during this review. sources-start.json and sources-final.json distinguish original and final hashes; final tested production files match firmware-002 manifest.
review_observations.speeduino: The entry writes authored raw ADC counts, executes run_loop(), and reads production currentStatus.MAP; no MAP/RPM/sync status injection was found in the entry. The production objects/inputs are attested and an unchanged binary was independently rerun. Source selects AVCC on AVR, while the native test models that relationship outside the binary; a separate sensor-only supply drop is explicitly exercised and not cancelled. Only8 declared acquisition/conversion cases are supported.
review_observations.late_test_only_updates: After production-source freeze and completed independent probes, the parent added the same93-check native reproduction wrapper, its docs command, and2 screenshot-only UI test lines (kPa label and waiting for toast disappearance). These were source-reviewed and copied into the final source map; the new wrapper and modified authored UI script were not additionally rerun by this reviewer. Production code, web/index.html and firmware-002 artifact hashes remain unchanged.

physical_holds: Physical engine outputs remain inhibited; this review grants no permission to operate an engine.

Actual sensor wiring/pinout/supply relationship, ground offsets, divider tolerances, ADC channel switching/sample skew/loading, reference error, current/fuse/wiring drop and thermal behavior require measured testing.
Actual ESP32 timing/RTOS/supervisor/watchdog/output-scheduler behavior, NVS capacity/fragmentation/wear/recovery/power-loss behavior and RF/EMI/surge/enclosure/environment remain unqualified.
Conversion acceptance at4..5.3V is distinct from the unchanged engine rail guard4.75..5.25V.

No full nonideal circuit sweep is accepted here. The authored idealized CPU/GPIO/regulator/sensor/ADC0..6 and sample-time assumptions cannot establish board limits. Parent-reported fixture nonconvergence is not classified as a product failure.

harness_corrections: First independent Chrome launch failed because the owned TMPDIR absolute socket path exceeded the UNIX socket path limit. Re-run changed CWD to owned tmp and set TMPDIR=. so all files remain owned; current UI run passed.

Initial radio harness used an unavailable read16 helper; replaced it with local byte decoding. First runtime attempted an exact4V synthetic rail that quantizes below4V; corrected valid-rail probes to4.01/5.29 while retaining strict invalidity tests. These were harness assumptions, not feature defects.
Initial full-HTTP compile exposed the harness content_len signedness choice; matched the pinned SDK size_t declaration and suppressed existing sign-compare warnings. ASan/UBSan execution then passed.
